name: connectwise-manage-mcp
description: ConnectWise Manage (PSA), with optional Automate and Control, in one MCP server. Read, write, and an interactive ticket card.
long_description:
One connector for the ConnectWise stack. PSA (Manage) is always available; Automate and Control (ScreenConnect) register themselves only when their credentials are configured, so an unconfigured integration contributes no tools rather than tools that fail.

Every tool is named cw_* and shows a Title Case name in the client. Tools come in three kinds and say which they are: read-only tools carry readOnlyHint and can run without a prompt; write tools declare themselves as writes; cw_get_ticket is interactive, rendering an MCP Apps card with an internal-note box on hosts that support it and plain JSON everywhere else.

PSA covers tickets, companies, contacts, configurations, time and expense entries, projects, agreements, invoices, opportunities, members, activities and schedule entries, plus board metadata and read/write escape hatches for endpoints without a dedicated tool.

UNLIKE THE OTHER CONNECTORS IN THIS FLEET, THIS ONE WRITES. It can create and update tickets, add ticket notes, and create time and expense entries. Three guardrails are not optional and must not be weakened: the raw read tools cannot issue anything but GET, cw_api_write refuses DELETE without confirm: true, and the Automate and Control write tools refuse every call without it.

This bundle is the LOCAL install: it runs on your own machine and holds the ConnectWise credentials there. The same tools are also served by a remote deployment on Azure Container Apps for clients that cannot launch a local process — see the repository documentation.

psa_site.title: PSA site
psa_site.description: Your ConnectWise Manage host, e.g. na.myconnectwise.net. The api- prefix is added automatically for cloud hosts.

psa_company_id.title: PSA company id
psa_company_id.description: The company identifier you log in with.

psa_public_key.title: PSA public key
psa_public_key.description: Public key of an API member. Give that member only the permissions these tools need — the connector can create tickets and time entries.

psa_private_key.title: PSA private key
psa_private_key.description: The matching private key. Supply it from your secret manager.

psa_client_id.title: ConnectWise clientId
psa_client_id.description: The developer clientId GUID sent with every request. Issued by ConnectWise; required by the API.

automate_url.title: Automate URL (optional)
automate_url.description: e.g. https://automate.example.com. Leave blank to register no Automate tools.

automate_username.title: Automate username (optional)
automate_username.description: Automate account username. Only used when the Automate URL is set.

automate_password.title: Automate password (optional)
automate_password.description: Automate account password. Supply it from your secret manager.

automate_client_id.title: Automate clientId (optional)
automate_client_id.description: Automate developer clientId GUID, sent with every Automate request.
